title: Flashcards 2
description: Mostly an app to study based on Flashcards. I created this project to study basics of programming during the day. It shows 20 cards randomly selected. Fully implemented with Jetpack Compose, Navigation 3 and Material 3. It also has offline support and unit and instrumentation testing.

title: TUI
description: This is a project to start to create TUI (Text User Interface) Apps. I'm learning Go and I'm using Bubble Tea as an externam module. I will eventually refactor my entire project of Bullying with Questions (originally a script shell) to TUI

title: Personal Website
description: This is my personal website where I share my experience, projects and blog posts. It is built with completely with vanilla JS, Tailwind CSS and HTML and hosted on GitHub Pages.

title: Compose Training
description: This is a project where I challenge myself by creating UI designs in Compose. I pick designs from various sources (mostly Google Stitch) and try to replicate them using Jetpack Compose and Material 3 Expressive. This helps me improve my skills and learn new techniques in Compose development.

title: Taximeter
description: This is a simple taximeter I started to work on while working with some fellow friends. It is built with Jetpack Compose and Material 3 Expressive. The app allows users to start, stop and reset the taximeter, as well as to set the rate per kilometer and the initial fare. The app also displays the total fare and the distance traveled.

title: Fight Info Retriever
description: This was my first project in backend /frontend development as a personal project (2014). It is a simple app that retrieves flight information from an API and displays it in a user-friendly way. The app allows users to search for flights by origin and destination, and view details such as departure and arrival times, flight duration, and airline information. It uses the API of Despegar.com and uses the early versions of Ember.js
